text:
Monica (People Ops): quick q — we have a salesperson (commission) asking about after-tax contributions + in-plan Roth conversion. Are they eligible given variable comp? any payroll caveats? :thinking:
Ben (People Ops): they're eligible to contribute after-tax if plan allows, but conversions depend on vendor admin. need to confirm in-service conversion rules and testing implications.
Jordan (FinOps): payroll needs stabilized income code. For commission, we pro-rate contribution limits each pay period based on gross for that check. For in-plan conversion, we must tag the source as `after_tax` so vendor can process rollover.
Alex (Eng): do we need a special enrollment form for commission splits? they get monthly commission draws + quarterly bonuses.
Ben (People Ops): yes — ask rep to pick "After-tax voluntary" in Workday. For bonuses, after-tax elections apply unless they opt out. Conversions typically run monthly/quarterly depending on vendor batch.
Payroll Bot: created ticket #PR-8342 to add `ATX_CONV` payroll deduction code for vendor intake.
Monica (People Ops): thanks! Jordan — do conversions trigger ADP/TPA nondiscrimination testing concerns? we want to avoid ADP failures.
Jordan (FinOps): might. if high earners max out and low earners don't, in-plan conversions reduce the after-tax balance but still count in testing. Recommend vendor-run pro forma test after next conversion run.
Ben (People Ops): I'll open a case with the TPA and request a sample conversion schedule. Anyone have sample form? here's the payroll snippet we give reps:
```
Employee action: select 'After-tax voluntary deferral'
Payroll code: ATX
Conversion tag: ATX_CONV
Effective date: next payroll
```
Alex (Eng): thx — also what about early leavers? if someone leaves mid-month with after-tax balance queued for conversion?
Jordan (FinOps): conversions are generally processed for terminated employees only on request; default is to leave as plan balance. We'll clarify with TPA.
Monica (People Ops): perfect. Ben, can you compile the vendor answer and update the benefits FAQ before EOD? :thumbsup:
Ben (People Ops): on it. I'll post update in #benefits and pester the TPA if no reply by 2pm.
